query:
UPDATE order_rounds
        SET status = $2,
            ready_at = CASE
                WHEN $2 = 'ready'::round_status AND ready_at IS NULL THEN now()
                ELSE ready_at
            END,
            served_at = CASE
                WHEN $2 = 'served'::round_status AND served_at IS NULL THEN now()
                ELSE served_at
            END,
            updated_at = now()
        WHERE id = $1 AND status IS DISTINCT FROM $2
        RETURNING id
